claim: Round 4 put two new clauses on H-AQUA that run on raised ways its definition does not hold. T-V6-47's 'later work across a standing raised way' (l. 4155; T110-2 (4)–(5), the END line placing them on H-AQUA) runs 'an epoch circuit across its standing aqueduct and one across a standing timber elevated road … an epoch route re-solved under a viaduct'. T-V6-73's 'under a crossing station' clause (l. 4181; VAP-r3-06) runs 'on H-AQUA's ring … its masonry aqueduct through the wall arch, its viaduct on a raised gate'. V06 §7 (l. 4056–4057) defines H-AQUA only as a town below a spring 4 km upslope, growing TOWN to CITY to METROPOLIS and back to TOWN over 200 years, its reach silted in year 170: an aqueduct, but no viaduct, raised gate or timber elevated road. T-V6-57 and T-V6-61 also name only its aqueduct. A generated viaduct or elevated road appears only where its reason holds (T110-3's drop and link reasons and the prosperity and landmark tendencies), which the definition does not state. So the viaduct, raised-gate and elevated-road parts of both clauses can run on nothing and pass vacuously. The tests name the parts, so a build agent would add them: the class of a fixture list omitting what its own clause runs.
required_change: V06 §7's H-AQUA definition adds, after 'in year 170': '; from CITY its walled ring is crossed by its masonry aqueduct through a wall opening and, where its main approach road crosses a valley, by a viaduct on a raised gate, and from METROPOLIS a timber elevated road stands between two of its landmarks — each declared in the fixture's recipe where generation does not lay it (a declared raised way is held, V06 §3.19.2 (1))'. T-V6-47's and T-V6-73's H-AQUA clauses then name 'its viaduct' and 'its timber elevated road' as these.

claim: V06 §6.8 (6) (l. 4015–4021) says: 'Where even one epoch over the span with its events' term passes the budget (a catch-up of many more dossier events than T-V6-24's fixtures carry), the catch-up folds that one epoch …'. Round 4 gave T-V6-24 a fourth catch-up fixture for exactly this branch: 100 years carrying 5 000 dossier events at the METROPOLIS cap, with an estimate of at least 19 310 ms. So 'than T-V6-24's fixtures carry' is now false of T-V6-24's own fixture. The paragraph's next sentence and T-V6-24's bar both say 'three catch-up fixtures'. Nothing built changes.
required_change: In V06 §6.8 (6), replace '(a catch-up of many more dossier events than T-V6-24's fixtures carry)' with '(a catch-up of many more dossier events than T-V6-24's three catch-up fixtures carry, as its over-budget fixture of 5 000 at the METROPOLIS cap)'.
